# Plan and Implement

## Change Summary

Aligned the process-parameter alkalinity default across all default-entry paths and tightened the generic conservation assertion formatting. `crates/tank_data/data/process/default.toml` now uses the precise round-trippable value for `NITRIFICATION_ALK_MEQ_PER_MG_N`, `crates/tank_data/src/presets.rs` now sources the serde fallback from the same named constant instead of a rounded literal, `crates/tank_data` regression coverage now asserts both the shipped preset and omitted-field defaults stay pinned to that constant, and `crates/tank_scenarios/src/lib.rs` now verifies preset-driven scenario params match `ProcessParams::default()`. In `crates/tank_core/src/budget_helpers.rs`, I centralized element label/unit rendering and switched the generic imbalance/per-tick panic details to use those helpers so the assertion paths no longer hard-code `mg` in their per-system and per-stage lines.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Inspected the cited process defaults, preset parsing defaults, scenario mapping, and budget-helper assertion formatting to confirm the actual divergence points and the available regression hooks.
2. [Completed] Patched the shipped process preset, the tank_data serde fallback, the tank_data/tank_scenarios regression coverage, and the generic budget-helper assertion formatting so unit strings are centralized instead of hard-coded in failure details.
3. [Completed] Ran formatting and targeted validation across tank_data, tank_scenarios, tank_core budget helpers, and the conservation regression suite to verify the amended defaults and helper changes compile and pass.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo fmt --all` completed successfully.
- `cargo fmt --all --check` passed.
- `cargo test -p tank_data test_backward_compatible_loading -- --nocapture` passed: 1 test passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo test -p tank_scenarios default_process_preset_matches_runtime_nitrification_alkalinity_constant -- --nocapture` passed: 1 test passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test budget_helpers -- --nocapture` passed: 13 tests passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test conservation_regression -- --nocapture` passed: 6 tests passed, 0 failed.

## Outstanding Risks

- `BudgetInspector` still tracks alkalinity only as stage metrics rather than as a first-class conserved ledger element, so there is not yet a dedicated `Element::Alkalinity` assertion path to exercise beyond the unit-formatting cleanup in the generic helpers.
